# `ew fmt`

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs-gen` from bin/ew/api/cli.json and bin/ew/schemas/. Do not edit: change the source and regenerate. -->

1 subcommand path(s). The synopsis lists the flags; `ew help` prints the positional arguments too.

## `ew fmt`

```text
ew fmt [--project <project>] [--check] [--json]
```

Stability: preview.

| Flag | Takes a value | Repeatable |
|---|---|---|
| `--project` | yes | no |
| `--check` | no | no |
| `--json` | no | no |

**Exit codes**

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | every file is canonical, or the files were rewritten and saved |
| 1 | `--check` found files to rewrite |
| 2 | usage, open, lock, a crashed session's journal, a content change and save errors |

**Result** (`--json`): `ew.fmt-result/1`, schema [`ew.fmt-result-1.schema.json`](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/bin/ew/schemas/ew.fmt-result-1.schema.json).

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `$schema` | `"ew.fmt-result/1"` | yes |  | The name of this schema. |
| `check` | boolean | yes |  | Whether this was `--check` (nothing is written). |
| `files` | array of [`FmtFile`](#fmtfile) | yes |  | The files not in canonical form, in path order. |
| `generation` | integer (format `uint64`, min 0) | yes |  | The generation on disk afterwards. |
| `kept` | array of [`KeptRow`](#keptrow) | yes |  | The lines (or files) kept verbatim as the open reported them: quarantined lines, malformed values, unknown kinds, members or files. |

### FmtFile

One file of `FmtResult`.

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `file` | string | yes |  | The file, relative to the project directory. |
| `removed` | boolean | yes |  | Whether nothing is left in it and it is removed (its records belong in other files). |

### KeptRow

One kept line of `FmtResult`.

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `code` | string | yes |  | The finding's rule (`EW-CORE-007`). |
| `file` | string | yes |  | The file, relative to the project directory. |
| `line` | integer (format `uint32`, min 0) or `null` | no |  | The 1-based line; `null` for a whole file. |
| `reason` | string | yes |  | Why it is kept. |
